subject: MAP draft: roles, milestones, and dependencies (please confirm owners)
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft: roles, milestones, and dependencies (please confirm owners)

Hi Daniel — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and an initial MAP draft attached (Nimbus-MAP-v0.2.xlsx). Please confirm the owners below so we can lock milestones and share with procurement/legal.

High-level objectives we agreed on:
- Run a 2-week pilot of Redwood inference for discharge-summary generation (scope: oncology workflows)
- Validate latency and token-cost targets for production scale (100 reqs/s target)
- Complete security and legal review to allow pilot access to de-identified EHR extracts

Proposed MAP milestones (target dates):
1) Pilot kickoff (env + creds provisioned) — target: 2026-06-30 — owner: Redwood (Aisha) / Nimbus IT (Sunil)
2) Security assessment & BAA scoping — target: 2026-06-25 — owner: Nimbus IT (Sunil) / Redwood security (Marissa)
3) Legal review & contract redlines — target: 2026-06-28 — owner: Nimbus Legal (Patricia) / Redwood legal (Priyom)
4) Pilot execution (2 weeks) — 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-14 — owner: Nimbus Eng (Miguel) / Redwood ops (Marissa)
5) Exec decision / PO or committed capacity — target: 2026-07-22 — owner: Economic buyer (Rachel)

Dependencies we flagged:
- Data access: secure S3 bucket + IAM roles (Nimbus IT)
- BAA / HIPAA scope confirmation from legal (Nimbus legal)
- Procurement lead for PO/Payment terms (Olivia Chen)

RACI (please confirm or correct):
- Economic buyer: Rachel Summers (Nimbus) [R]
- Security owner: Sunil Rao (Nimbus IT) [A]
- Legal owner: Patricia Long (Nimbus Legal) [C]
- Engineering lead: Miguel Torres (Nimbus Eng) [I/A?]

Ask: can you confirm the four named owners (economic buyer/security/legal/eng lead) and call out any missing stakeholders (procurement, data protection officer, or clinical safety owner)? If these look right we’ll update the MAP and circulate a version for signatures.

Attachments: Nimbus-MAP-v0.2.xlsx (MAP, milestones tab), Nimbus-SOW-draft.docx (SOW template)

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mailto:aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0126

From: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@nimbushealth.com>

Subject: Re: MAP draft: roles, milestones, and dependencies (please confirm owners)

Thanks Aisha — good summary. A few confirmations from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Rachel Summers (CFO) — confirmed.
- Security owner: Sunil Rao (Head of IT Security) — confirmed, I’ll ask Sunil to start the security checklist.
- Legal owner: Patricia Long (in-house counsel) — she will lead redlines, but Olivia in procurement will own contract execution.
- Engineering lead: Miguel Torres — confirmed, Miguel will be our point for onboarding and pilot instrumentation.

One request: please add Olivia Chen (Procurement) to the MAP as the procurement owner (Olivia.chen@nimbushealth.com). She runs contracts/POs and will need the SOW and estimated burn to route for PO approval. Also note our clinical safety reviewer (Dr. Lena Park) should be aware of the pilot; she’s not the owner but should be on the distribution list.

Quick question on dependencies: do you anticipate needing a signed BAA before we provide any sample EHR extracts, even if de-identified? If so we’ll ask legal to prioritize.

—Daniel
Director, Product | Nimbus Health

Subject: Re: MAP draft: roles, milestones, and dependencies (please confirm owners)

Daniel — thanks for the fast confirmations and the heads-up on procurement/clinical safety. A few operational notes from our side to make timelines realistic: 

- We’ll update the MAP to add Olivia Chen as procurement owner and add Dr. Lena Park to the stakeholder distribution list.
- Regarding the BAA: our standard practice is to have a BAA in place before exchanging PHI or re-identifiable datasets. For de-identified extracts we can proceed under a Data Use Agreement, but we’ll defer to Nimbus legal. If you need, we can share our BAA template for redlines this week.
- Suggested adjusted milestones (small shifts to allow legal review):
  * Security assessment complete: 2026-06-29 (was 06-25) — gives Sunil a couple more days
  * Legal redlines returned: 2026-07-02 (was 06-28)
  * Pilot kickoff: 2026-07-06 (was 06-30)
  * Pilot end & exec review: 2026-07-20

Action items from Redwood: Priyom will own coordinating legal + SOW redline turnaround; Marissa will start the security intake and share our security questionnaire (I’ve attached the current MAP and a short SOW draft).

Please reply with confirmation that the adjusted dates work and whether Nimbus legal wants the BAA template now. Once we have sign-off on owners and dates we’ll circulate a final MAP for signatures and update the HubSpot deal (link below).

Link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/6914

Thanks,

All — thanks for the quick replies and confirmations. I’ve updated the MAP (attached: Nimbus-MAP-v0.2.xlsx) to reflect:
- Procurement owner: Olivia Chen (added)
- Clinical safety reviewer: Dr. Lena Park (added to watchers)
- Adjusted milestone dates per Priyom’s suggested cadence
- Noted BAA requirement as a dependency; Priyom will share Redwood’s template for legal review

Next steps:
1) Patricia / Nimbus legal: please confirm whether you want the BAA template or prefer to work from your in-house version. If you can return redlines by 2026-07-02 we’ll keep the pilot kickoff on 2026-07-06.
2) Sunil / Nimbus IT: please start the security intake checklist and let us know if any additional evidence is required for our SOC2 reports.
3) Olivia / Procurement: I’ve attached the SOW draft and an estimated token burn/cost summary for PO planning. Can you confirm the PO contact and timing for approvals?

I’ll update HubSpot (deal DEAL-6914) and circulate a signature-ready MAP once we have legal and procurement alignment.
